title: Marrakech's Brahim El Mazned Receives UNESCO-Sharjah Prize for Arab Culture
body:
Brahim El Mazned, founder of the Timitar Festival and the driving force behind Gnawa music's 2019 UNESCO inscription, received the UNESCO-Sharjah Prize for Arab Culture 2026 at a ceremony in Paris.

His Legacy

El Mazned transformed Timitar from a local gathering into an internationally recognised world music platform with 400,000+ annual attendees. His decade-long UNESCO campaign established Gnawa as a protected intangible heritage, ensuring its preservation for future generations.

Source: UNESCO official announcement, via Kech24.
